seo.title: Q — an AI survey maker that writes and reads your surveys
seo.description: Q drafts a survey from one sentence and reads the answers back for you: the model writes the questions, you edit them, and once the responses are in it tells you what they add up to.
seo.keywords: AI survey maker, questionnaire generator, form builder, survey analysis, poll
